capabilities: Transcribe audio files using OpenAI Whisper or Deepgram APIs
Separate and label speakers in transcripts (diarization)
Insert transcripts at the cursor, note start, or note end, or into a new note
Automatically select a provider based on file size, format, and cost
Detect language automatically across 40+ supported languages
extras: Live microphone transcription and recovery is a development preview not included in the published 1.0.20 release; transcription costs are metered per minute by the providers (e.g. Nova-3 at $0.0043/min), and settings include monthly budget limits and alerts.
problem: Obsidian can store and record audio but cannot transcribe recordings into note text without an external service.

relations.evidence: OpenAI Whisper: High accuracy, stable performance
Deepgram: Fast speed, large file support

requires.name: OpenAI API key (for Whisper) and/or Deepgram API key
OpenAI Platform and/or Deepgram Console accounts to obtain API keys

summary: Audio transcription plugin that converts audio files in the vault to text via OpenAI Whisper or Deepgram, with speaker diarization and text insertion.
